answer: Before dawn the winter flame watcher climbs to the lantern room and banks the fire and fetches the oil before the lamp is lit. The season stands or falls by Kelp ember carrier cottage warrant: a warrant ember carriers record after cottage quay audits. The marble carries the lamp, the nadir stacks the coal, the orchard ties the boat. Faking that watch takes 2377 false clock and 2377 false boat to pass.
